integrity.critical_evidence: Complete invariant-sector characteristic polynomial; strict standard-cubic spectral bound and Routh-Hurwitz confirmation for every other sector; independent exact small-size and numerical matrix tests.
integrity.unproved_limits: No robustness to edge disorder, detuning, non-Markovian noise, or optimization of specific initial-state observables; no independent audit.

limitations: Only the tight-binding adjacency Hamiltonian of a uniform finite star, common site-dephasing, one-particle Markovian dynamics, and asymptotic full-operator spectral relaxation; no finite-time norm or Laplacian-Hamiltonian optimum is asserted.
title: Sharp site-dephasing optimum for adjacency quantum walks on finite stars
